title: A bill to amend the Federal Water Pollution Control Act.
short_title: A bill to amend the Federal Water Pollution Control Act.

actions.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Environment and Public Works.

latest_action.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Environment and Public Works.

summaries.text: Amends the Federal Water Pollution Control Act to require applicants for Federal licenses for activities which may result in water quality degradation or impairment of designated State uses in navigable waters to provide a certification from the affected State that such activities will not result in such degradation or impairment and will protect the water quality and uses identified in the State's water quality standards.
